title: System Explorer collect stream record
description: One NDJSON line of a collect batch (DESIGN 19). A committed collection is authoritative; an uncommitted one is authoritative for nothing. There is no partial commit and no tombstone: everything a committed collection did not emit is gone, and a decline of absent commits empty.

declaration.description: sha256 of the declaration this stream was produced under. Unknown hash: the batch is held un-applied until fetched (DESIGN 25).

timens.description: The collector's CLOCK_BOOTTIME namespace offset. A mismatch with the collator is stated, never corrected (DESIGN 09).

instance.description: Fleet-assigned instance this collector fronts; ids, origins and relations mint under (host, instance) scope. Null means host-native (DESIGN 11, 19).

generations.description: Collator-issued monotonic generation per collection, echoed. Below-applied commits are refused (DESIGN 19). A fresh acquisition always takes a new generation; retransmission of already-captured output may reuse one.

names.description: Every native name observed for this thing, split by stability class; a join runs on stable only (DESIGN 16, 19).

absent.description: Declared facts this object genuinely lacks. We looked; there is no such property. Distinct from unobservable (DESIGN 19, 27).

digest.description: Over the redacted payload as served. JSON under the named canon; any other media type over exact post-redaction bytes (DESIGN 19).

at.description: CLOCK_BOOTTIME seconds, stamped immediately before the earliest contributing native read, so age never understates (DESIGN 09, 19).

target.description: A name and a kind, never an id, and never an observability: whether the far end was seen is a fact about another collector's output, which only the collator holds (DESIGN 13, 19).

relation_assertion.description: A collector never states observability — whether the far end was seen is a fact about another collector's output, which only the collator holds — and a target carries a name, never an id (DESIGN 13, 19). Both are encoded as negatives.

reason.description: The decline vocabulary minus absent: could-not-read-because-it-is-not-there is the absent list's statement, on its own channel (DESIGN 19).

detail.description: Bounded and scrubbed at the collator boundary; this string travels to a hub and out over MCP (DESIGN 19).

decline.description: absent is a successful reading and is followed by a zero-object commit; the other three never commit and mark prior state stale (DESIGN 19).

commit.description: Always the whole collection: v1 has no partial commit, so a complete member may not appear (DESIGN 19).
